title: PolicyOverlay
description:
One agent's overlay: the identity it applies to, a version reflex cites
on every classification the overlay changed, and the per-verb narrowings.

agent.description:
The reflex identity the rules apply to — `soma/<function>`. Must equal
the owning FunctionAgent's identity; the operator refuses to project
an overlay that names a different agent (one function cannot narrow
another's policy through its own ConfigMap).

rules.description: The narrowings. Each verb at most once.

version.description:
Free-form version token cited as `@<seed>+<version>` in the
classification's `policy` id when the overlay changed the outcome.
Non-empty; a date or a counter is the convention.

OverlayRule.description:
A narrowing for one verb. Both fields optional; an entry with neither is
rejected by [`PolicyOverlay::validate`].

threshold.description:
Require at least this many sign-off points on a RED card if it is
HIGHER than the seed's threshold; a lower value is ignored by reflex.

tier.description:
Hold the verb at this tier if it is MORE restrictive than the seed's
(GREEN < YELLOW < RED < NEVER); a less restrictive value is ignored by
reflex. `NEVER` is allowed: sealing is narrowing.

Tier.description:
The four-rung gate ladder (soma §5.1), generalized from godseat's cluster
Green/Yellow/Red/Never to enterprise verbs.

Serializes UPPERCASE to match the §8 wire (`"tier": "RED"`).

oneOf.description: Autonomous; audited. (read, triage, draft, internal file/ticket, report)
Notify-and-proceed; the founder can veto within a window.

Verb.description:
The starter verb taxonomy for instance #0 (soma §5.1).

Serializes kebab-case to match the wire (`file-internal`, `send-external`,
`hire-engage`, `grant-access`, `delete-destroy`, `commit-code`).

oneOf.description: Delegated to terrarium's existing commit gates (soma §5.1).
